note: Chemin des Gestes place 1/4; landmark: bronze statue of two giant shaking hands on a stone plinth under a blooming cherry tree. First place: the cherry lane leaves the Home square behind the viewer (back = near cobbles). -er figures on the left; tendre (girl and donkey) on the right below the handshake statue. Lettering on the plinth was removed. Minor: the handshake couple's shoes run into the bottom 6% band (box stops at 676). No -er/-ir markers, no painted text.
